hero.heading: Invest in Brand Equity, Not Just Businesses
hero.description: Access a new alternative asset class with fractional ownership, transparent deployment, and lower risk than traditional startup investing. Track performance in real-time.

model.title: The Fractional Investment Model
model.subtitle: Replace institutional VCs with retail investors through fractional ownership

steps.title: Evaluate Brand Vision
steps.description: Review compelling brand visions from founders. Assess the differentiated perception they want to create and founder quality.

steps.title: Fractional Investment
steps.description: Invest small amounts in brands you believe in. Fractional ownership means diversification across multiple brands instead of going all-in on one.

steps.title: Direct Funding
steps.description: Your investment flows directly to approved channels and creators who build brand equity. No money goes to operational expenses you can't track.

steps.title: Track Performance
steps.description: Monitor brand growth through Share of Voice, Share of Market, and Excess Share of Voice metrics in real-time.

steps.title: Own Brand Value
steps.description: You own fractional shares of the brand value being created. Similar to crowdfunding, but instead of pre-ordering products, you own brand equity.

benefits.title: Benefits for Retail Investors
benefits.subtitle: Access previously exclusive investment opportunities with better transparency

items.title: Alternative Asset Class
items.description: Access to brand equity investment previously reserved for VCs. Diversify your portfolio beyond traditional stocks and real estate.

items.title: Transparent Deployment
items.description: Capital visibly goes to actual brand-building activities. See exactly where your money flows - to channels, creators, and campaigns.

items.title: Real-Time Tracking
items.description: Track performance through SOV, SOM, and eSOV metrics in real-time. Know if the brand is gaining mindshare and market position.

items.title: Lower Risk Profile
items.description: Money goes to established service providers who get paid regardless of business outcome. Lower risk than traditional startup investing.

items.title: Small Investment Amounts
items.description: Can invest small amounts in brand visions you believe in. Fractional ownership makes brand equity accessible to all.

items.title: Portfolio Diversification
items.description: Diversify across multiple brands instead of single large bets. Spread risk while supporting multiple emerging businesses.

risk.title: Risk Comparison
risk.subtitle: Why brand investment has a fundamentally different risk profile

comparisons.title: Traditional VC Model
comparisons.description: If business fails, money is gone - spent on inventory, payroll, rent that generated no return. Capital disappears with the business.

comparisons.title: Brand Investment Model
comparisons.description: Money flows through established media and marketing channels who get paid for services rendered, regardless of business outcome. Channels receive payment whether brand succeeds or not.

comparisons.title: Following the Money
comparisons.description: Brand-building capital doesn't disappear - it flows to Google for ad spend, production companies for videos, influencers for content, and media outlets for placement. The money goes to established entities.

metrics.title: Track Brand Performance
metrics.subtitle: True foresight metrics that predict brand success

items.name: Share of Voice (SOV)
items.description: How much conversation and mental real estate the brand owns in its category. Measures breakthrough and awareness.
items.insight: Tells you if the brand is getting noticed in its market

items.name: Share of Market (SOM)
items.description: The brand's actual current market position. Shows if attention is converting to market share.
items.insight: Reveals if awareness is translating to actual business

items.name: Excess Share of Voice (eSOV)
items.description: The delta between SOV and SOM. Research shows when Share of Voice exceeds Share of Market, it's a leading indicator of future market share growth.
items.insight: Predicts growth - winning mindshare before market share

comparison.title: Traditional VC vs. Vaizen Model
comparison.subtitle: Two fundamentally different approaches to funding brand-building

models.name: Vaizen Model
points: Lower risk - money goes to service providers
